Date Completed: October 2026

Subsystem: Timing

Summary:

The ReflexOS Timing Doctrine establishes the authoritative timing architecture for all ReflexOS systems running on Qualcomm QRB5165 hardware.

The doctrine defines:

• Timing hierarchy

• Validation methodology

• WCET methodology

• Failure recovery

• Certification requirements

• Governance controls

• Traceability requirements

• Audit procedures

• Accessibility timing rules

• Safety timing rules
